name: FieldLine HEDscan / FLv2

specs.form_factor: wearable helmet, allows natural head movement

cost.system: not publicly stated; estimated $300k-600k for full clinical system

deployment: Phase-2 clinical trials with epilepsy and Parkinson's patients (2024-2025). Two US academic medical centres (2024). 40+ clinical sites globally (early 2026).
bci_relevance: Clinical-grade wearable OPM-MEG. Best timing performance among commercial systems (1.2 ms latency). Not accessible to independent researcher at this price but defines the gold standard for wearable quantum MEG.
